message: I'd support you in that kind of change--and I think that Collin's point is a good one, and as someone who has watched our Women's Studies program prepare for hosting  a conference next week, I'd like to see that whatever happens is efficient and fair to the conference organizers who have to read/sort/accept/reject all of our proposals.  I have a half-formed idea that it would be interesting to have a "wild card" category:  put three unrelated presenters together and have them spend the year discussing how and whether their ideas intersect. . .or not, and then bring that to the conference, so the that the discussion is formed from moment to moment (kind of like a blog!).
